name: SkillTrustBench
description: Security benchmark for agent skills, distilled from real skill marketplaces.
descriptionZh: 面向 Agent Skill 的安全基准，用例提炼自真实技能市场。
frontier: 5,520 evaluation cases across 9 attack categories (T01-T09) and 5 dependency layers
frontierZh: 5,520 个评测用例，覆盖 9 类攻击（T01-T09）与 5 个依赖层
credibility: Notable for scale of provenance: the cases were distilled from 62,652 real skills taken from major skill marketplaces, so it tests the threats that actually ship rather than hand-invented ones. Published June 2026 by Tencent Zhuque Lab with CUHK-Shenzhen.
credibilityZh: 其价值在于来源规模：用例提炼自主流技能市场中 62,652 个真实 Skill，因此测的是真实发布出来的威胁，而非凭空设计的攻击。2026 年 6 月由腾讯朱雀实验室与香港中文大学（深圳）联合发布。
keyFact: SkillTrustBench, released in June 2026 by Tencent Zhuque Lab and CUHK-Shenzhen, distilled 5,520 evaluation cases covering nine attack categories from 62,652 real skills found in mainstream skill marketplaces.
keyFactZh: 腾讯朱雀实验室与香港中文大学（深圳）于 2026 年 6 月发布的 SkillTrustBench，从主流技能市场的 62,652 个真实 Skill 中提炼出 5,520 个评测用例，覆盖九类攻击。
